description: Source code for a BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) module, including functions for managing BPF objects, maps, programs, and debugging within a runtime environment.

classes.name: uc_bpf_fd
classes.description: Structure representing a BPF file descriptor with a close flag.

classes.name: uc_bpf_map
classes.description: Structure representing a BPF map with associated file descriptor and key/value sizes.

classes.name: uc_bpf_map_iter
classes.description: Iterator structure for traversing BPF map keys.

methods.name: uc_bpf_error
methods.description: Returns the last error message or code related to BPF operations.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_module
methods.description: Opens and loads a BPF module from a file path with optional settings.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_create
methods.description: Creates a new BPF map resource.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_map
methods.description: Opens an existing BPF map by its file path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_open_program
methods.description: Opens a BPF program by its file path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_maps
methods.description: Retrieves all maps within a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_map
methods.description: Retrieves a specific map by name from a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_programs
methods.description: Retrieves all programs within a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_module_get_program
methods.description: Retrieves a specific program by name from a BPF module.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_get
methods.description: Gets an element from a BPF map by key.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_set
methods.description: Sets an element in a BPF map.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_delete
methods.description: Deletes an element from a BPF map.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_delete_all
methods.description: Deletes all elements from a BPF map, optionally filtered by a callable.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator for traversing BPF map keys.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iter_next
methods.description: Gets the next key from a BPF map iterator.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_iter_next_int
methods.description: Gets the next key as an integer from a BPF map iterator.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all map entries, calling a provided function.

methods.name: uc_bpf_obj_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF object (map or program) to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_program_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF program to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_map_pin
methods.description: Pins a BPF map to a filesystem path.

methods.name: uc_bpf_set_tc_hook
methods.description: Sets up a traffic control hook for a network interface.

methods.name: uc_bpf_program_tc_attach
methods.description: Attaches a BPF program to a traffic control hook.

methods.name: uc_bpf_tc_detach
methods.description: Detaches a BPF program from a traffic control hook.

methods.name: uc_bpf_set_debug_handler
methods.description: Sets a custom debug print handler for BPF logs.
